review_candidates.title: Head of IT - Remote
review_candidates.description: About Zyte At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast, and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data. For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data quickly, dependably, and at scale. Today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web. The Role Zyte is looking for a Head of IT to lead our internal technology function into the AI era. This is emphatically not a helpdesk-manager role: at Zyte, internal IT is an engineering and enablement discipline. You will own the systems the whole company runs on: our business applications, the integrations and automation that connect them, our identity and security backbone, and, front and center, the internal AI tooling that is changing how every Zytan works. You will lead two teams: IT Support, which keeps a globally distributed, remote-first workforce productive with a person-first service philosophy, and IT Tooling & Automation, an engineering pod that builds the integrations, internal services, and AI-driven workflows behind the scenes. You are a player-coach: comfortable setting a multi-year internal-platform strategy in the morning and reviewing an automation script or an AI workflow design in the afternoon. AI is the heart of this role. Zyte builds AI-powered products, and we run our company the same way: AI coding assistants across engineering, AI workflows in operations, and a growing internal AI platform. You will own this landscape end to end - selecting and administering the tools, governing seats, usage and cost, hardening the guardrails, and partnering with our AI Enablement function so that adoption translates into real productivity, not shelfware. If a task at Zyte is manual, we want it automated; if it is automated, we want to know whether an agent should be doing it. What You'll Do Lead the IT organisation Own strategy, roadmap, budget and vendor landscape for all of internal IT: support, business applications, integrations, automation, and internal AI tooling Lead, grow and develop the IT Support and IT Tooling & Automation teams; be the escalation point and the standard-setter for both Run IT as a product for employees: measure the experience (SLIs/SLOs on the things that matter to Zytans), publish what you ship, and prioritise by business leverage Own the business application landscape Administer, integrate and continuously rationalise our business-critical SaaS systems: CRM and marketing (Salesforce, HubSpot), finance and billing, HR platforms, support platforms, and collaboration and engineering tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub, Notion) Design reliable, API-driven workflows and data synchronization across platforms - one coherent, automated architecture instead of a pile of disconnected tools Own vendor selection, consolidation, licensing and renewals with a clear cost-versus-value view Automate everything worth automating Champion a code-first automation culture: scripts, internal services, event-driven pipelines (APIs and webhooks), internal CLI tools and ChatOps - not just SaaS configuration Build and evolve the internal 'IT Golden Path': automated onboarding and offboarding, identity and access provisioning, and self-service for the common 80% of IT requests Set the technical bar for the IT Tooling & Automation pod and review its designs; contribute hands-on where it moves the needle Lead internal AI tooling and adoption Own the company's internal AI tool portfolio (AI coding assistants such as Claude Code and Copilot, chat and agent platforms, AI features inside our SaaS estate): evaluation, procurement, account and seat administration, usage and cost governance, and lifecycle Ship AI into internal workflows: AI-powered support assistants, LLM-driven knowledge retrieval across internal documentation, automated ticket triage and resolution, and agentic automation of operational processes Partner closely with the AI Enablement function and the AI champions network: IT provides the tools, access, guardrails and administration; enablement embeds them into each team's daily work Define the sensible-use guardrails together with Security and Legal (data handling, model and vendor policies) so teams can move fast safely Measure adoption and return: usage and cost analytics per tool and team, and a clear view of where AI actually saves time or removes work Run IT service management, security and compliance Deliver superior, person-first IT support to a global, remote workforce, with root-cause analysis rather than symptom-fixing Own the employee identity and device backbone: SSO/SAML/SCIM provisioning, identity lifecycle automation, MDM (JumpCloud), password management and access audits under Zero Trust principles Partner with Information Security to keep us continuously compliant (ISO 27001) and audit-ready, embedding compliance into automated processes instead of manual checklists What Success Looks Like Employees are unblocked fast and onboarding/offboarding runs itself: measurable service levels, near-zero manual provisioning The business application landscape is consolidated, integrated and documented - data flows between systems without swivel-chair work AI tools are genuinely adopted across the company with governed cost and measurable time savings - and Zyte is visibly ahead of the curve in how a company runs itself on AI Manual internal work keeps disappearing: every quarter, processes that used to need a person are automated or agent-assisted Audits pass without heroics, and security posture improves while friction goes down The IT team grows in capability and reputation: an engineering team the rest of the company wants to work with You Are A builder-leader You have led IT, business systems or internal platform teams, and you still think like an engineer. You lead from the front, set a high technical bar, and are happiest when your team ships things that make work disappear. AI-driven You are genuinely excited about running a company on AI. You have rolled out AI tooling to real teams, you experiment constantly yourself, and you have a strong point of view on what works, what is hype, and how to govern usage and cost without killing adoption. Automation-obsessed Manual, repetitive work offends you. Your default answer to a recurring task is a script, a service, an integration or an agent - and you know when the pragmatic answer is a SaaS checkbox instead. People-centric You solve for the person, not just the machine. You communicate clearly with everyone from new joiners to the C-level, and you build a service culture your colleagues actually like dealing with. Security-minded You understand the 'why' behind security frameworks, MDM and Zero Trust, and you balance safety with organizational speed. Commercially sharp You treat the internal stack like a portfolio: you negotiate with vendors, consolidate overlapping tools, and can always say what something costs and what it returns. Requirements 10+ years in IT engineering, business systems engineering or internal platform engineering at SaaS/tech companies, including 3+ years leading a team that owned internal business systems and automation. A hands-on engineering background you have kept alive: you can still read, review and (when needed) write automation code in Python or a comparable language, and you are fluent with APIs, webhooks, OAuth flows and integration frameworks Proven ownership of a modern SaaS business application landscape (e.g. Salesforce or HubSpot, billing/finance systems, HR platforms, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub, Notion) including cross-system integration and data synchronization at company scale Demonstrated delivery of AI tooling into an organisation: LLM-based assistants, knowledge retrieval, AI-assisted support or agentic workflow automation - including the unglamorous parts (account administration, seat and usage governance, cost control, guardrails) Deep identity and security experience: SSO/SAML/SCIM, identity lifecycle automation, MDM (e.g. JumpCloud), Zero Trust access models Experience supporting or passing security and compliance audits (ISO 27001, SOC2, GDPR) Vendor and budget management experience: selection, negotiation, consolidation and license management across a substantial SaaS portfolio Experience serving a remote-first, globally distributed workforce with a person-first service philosophy Excellent communication in English, across technical and non-technical audiences up to executive level Strong Nice-to-Haves Experience with agentic platforms and protocols (e.g. MCP), the Claude / Gemini Enterprise / OpenAI / Copilot ecosystems, or building internal agents on LLM APIs FinOps-style governance of AI and cloud spend (usage analytics, per-seat economics, chargeback or showback) An SRE mindset applied to internal IT: SLIs/SLOs on the 'uptime' of the employee experience Experience consolidating tool landscapes after growth or M&A It's not expected that any one candidate will bring deep expertise across every area. We are looking for someone who is especially strong in several of them, and excited to grow in the others. Benefits Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multicultural team Have total flexibility: we are 100% remote, work from where you are most productive Join an innovation culture: we encourage 'hacking' internal processes - if a task is manual, we want you to automate it Work with a modern tool and AI stack, with the freedom and budget to shape it Shape a strategic area of the business with high visibility and real impact

review_candidates.description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! About The Role We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help modernize a legacy platform into a unified operations and inventory system. Working across Node.js APIs and React frontends, this person will own features end to end, using AI tools like Claude or Copilot to speed up development and testing. Comfort with cloud platforms and Infrastructure as Code rounds out the role. What You Will Do Build and maintain scalable backend services and responsive frontend web components for the "Rise" Franchisee portal. Design, develop, and maintain secure Node.js APIs and microservices to support the ecosystem (both web and mobile clients). Use Claude or Github Copilot as a development accelerator, generating code scaffolding, writing and reviewing tests, creating documentation, and prototyping solutions. Own the engineering lifecycle for your features: architecture, implementation, testing, CI/CD, and production monitoring. Write clean, well-tested TypeScript / JavaScript code; maintain high standards through code review and documentation. Collaborate with DevOps and other engineers to implement best practices around observability, security, and compliance. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve web defects, API bottlenecks, and production issues. Participate in Agile or product-centric delivery practices including sprint planning and retrospectives. MUST HAVES 2+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong experience developing software in TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and ReactJS. Strong understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems. Experience working with databases (specifically PostgreSQL) and core data persistence concepts. Hands-on experience with cloud hosting platforms such as Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS), including deploying, managing, and supporting applications. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and CI/CD using Azure DevOps. Experience developing high-quality, maintainable code while adhering to secure coding standards and industry security best practices to prevent vulnerabilities. Upper-Intermediate English level. NICE TO HAVES Experience with legacy platform migrations, ETL processes, or managing data hygiene when porting old systems. Familiarity with observability, logging, and monitoring tools like Dynatrace and CloudWatch. Experience in the QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) industry. Perks And Benefits Growth without limits: build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget Competitive compensation: get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews Flexibility: work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm Meaningful, modern projects: build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands Collaborative culture: join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized Well-being & support: access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location Meet Our Recruitment Process Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit. If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

review_candidates.title: Principal Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: The Role BJAK builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them. The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems . This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production. What You'll Own Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives. Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure. Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving. Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability. Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans. Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices. Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams. What We're Looking For 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems. Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure. Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems. Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on. Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production. Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems. Nice to have Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth. Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries. Location This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Technical interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Du wirst Teil eines internationalen Teams, das Kunden durch die Bereitstellung von Mautlösungen unterstützt. Als Full Stack Developer entwirfst, entwickelst und wartest du moderne Webanwendungen und Backend-Services und arbeitest mit modernen Entwicklungsframeworks und Technologien. Du nimmst am gesamten Software-Entwicklungslebenszyklus teil, vom Design bis zum Produktionssupport, und arbeitest eng mit Product Ownern, Architekten, DevOps Engineers, QA Engineers und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen. Jenkins) Erfahrung mit Docker Erfahrung mit Kubernetes Verständnis von Software-Qualitätsprinzipien Verständnis von Clean-Code-Praktiken Verständnis von automatisiertem Testen Verständnis von TDD (Test-Driven Development) Vertrautheit mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum, Kanban oder SAFe Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten Proaktive Denkweise Ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse in der Kommunikation Teamplayer mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten Von Vorteil Erfahrung mit AWS oder anderen Cloud-Plattformen Kenntnisse in Helm Kenntnisse in Artifactory Kenntnisse in Infrastruktur-Automatisierung Erfahrung in einem SAFe-Umfeld Kenntnisse des Apache Wicket Komponentenmodells Erfahrung im Bereich Mobilität, Transport oder Mautsysteme Deutschkenntnisse Über uns Als attraktivster Arbeitgeber Ungarns 2025 (laut repräsentativer Umfrage von Randstad) ist Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions eine Tochtergesellschaft der Deutsche Telekom Gruppe. Das Unternehmen bietet mit mehr als 5300 Mitarbeitern ein breites Portfolio an IT- und Telekommunikationsdienstleistungen. Wir haben Hunderte von Großkunden und Unternehmen in Deutschland und anderen europäischen Ländern. DT-ITS erhielt 2019 den Best in Educational Cooperation Award von HIPA und wurde als ethischstes multinationales Unternehmen 2019 anerkannt. Das Unternehmen entwickelt seine vier Standorte in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs und Szeged kontinuierlich weiter und sucht qualifizierte IT-Fachkräfte, die Teil des Teams werden möchten. Weitere Details Bitte beachte, dass unsere Remote-Work-Möglichkeit aufgrund europäischer Steuervorschriften nur innerhalb Ungarns verfügbar ist.

Das Unternehmen entwickelt seine vier Standorte in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs und Szeged kontinuierlich weiter und sucht qualifizierte IT-Fachkräfte, die Teil des Teams werden möchten. Weitere Details Bitte beachte, dass unsere Remote-Work-Möglichkeit aufgrund europäischer Steuervorschriften nur innerhalb Ungarns verfügbar ist.
